result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (branch feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Checksum install safety and PATH guidance verified correct, including a tampered-archive negative test. No source changes; /workspace/repo left at baseline 5672ead clean. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
result.details:
Method: read-only review of the full target tree in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/opencode/rv/review (git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895), plus a dependency-installed probe copy at /tmp/opencode/rv/probe. Reviewed README.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ENVIRONMENT.md, docs/SERVE.md, .env.example, package.json scripts, scripts/package.ts, src/settings/load.ts, src/settings/paths.ts, src/settings/inspect.ts, src/cli.ts, src/cli/arguments.ts, src/config.ts, src/main.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/store.ts. Diff vs base 5672ead shows the branch adds README/serve/package guidance plus --no-env-file scripts and build/package scripts, and leaves .env.example and docs/ENVIRONMENT.md untouched, which is the root of findings 1, 2 and 4.

Reproduced: `serve --check-config` exits 1 naming all six required values when a filled .env is present but not passed; the same command with `--env-file .env` exits 0 ok:true with db_path anchored at cwd. `config show` with no SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH and an isolated HOME reports <HOME>/.local/share/swarmforge/swarmforge.sqlite, source default, proving ENVIRONMENT.md:31 is stale. `serve --check-config --env-file ./secrets.env` in an empty dir resolves <cwd>/data/swarmforge.sqlite and creates nothing, proving both the relative anchoring and the documented read-only behaviour of config reads.

Verified correct, no finding: archive layout is flat (metadata-<v>.json, SHA256SUMS, swarmforge) and SHA256SUMS is `"<sha256>  swarmforge\n"` (scripts/package.ts:75-77,310-320), matching the README install block. Executed the README block verbatim on a synthetic archive: good archive -> exit 0, 'swarmforge: OK', installed 0755; repacked archive with an edited payload -> exit 1, 'swarmforge: FAILED' plus checksum warning, ~/.local/bin never created, so the README's errexit claim holds (tests/packaging.test.ts:1043 also executes this block). PATH guidance is correct for the compiled binary. All documented CLI commands exist and behave as described (src/cli/arguments.ts, src/cli.ts:194-247). CONFIGURATION.md precedence, anchoring, XDG absolute-only rule and :memory: pass-through match the code. ENVIRONMENT.md defaults other than SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH all match src/config.ts. systemd Type=exec, TimeoutStopSec=90s, 60000 shutdown default and exit 70 are consistent (src/serve-command.ts:9,12).

Why guards did not prevent the findings: tests/packaging.test.ts:851 asserts only that the scripts contain --no-env-file and :871 tests the corrected --env-file form, so the stale README quickstart is unverified; tests/settings.test.ts:169-184 asserts the new XDG default, so code and tests agree while the doc cell is stale; no test parses README.md:9/:12, ENVIRONMENT.md's default table, or a systemd unit.

Limitation: finding 3's systemd consequence is code-evidenced (default cwd /) plus reproduced anchoring, not executed against systemd. Full suite, packaging compiles and any provider/VM smoke were deliberately not run. No credentials read or emitted.
